head: a2f39fa
auditScope: Home, Chats, Projects, Files, Activity, More/Settings
summary: The app is feature-dense: 5-destination shell, Home attention digest, server-owned Projects CRUD, Chats browser with pin/batch/move/archive/undo + search modes, durable turn recovery, approvals/clarifications/sensitive prompts, model/effort selectors, attachments, STT/TTS, markdown with code copy/wrap, Cron CRUD, encrypted backup. The highest-value gaps are Discord-parity signals Carlos needs daily: (1) no unread/new indication even though the gateway already exposes the `unread`/`hidden` flags, (2) no per-message timestamps, (3) chat app-bar actions are only Refresh/Export (no rename/delete in-chat), (4) Memory and Files are read-only/text-only, (5) two More-pane entries under-report capabilities that are already shipped (Pin/batch/undo, AI-assisted filing settings).

findings.title: Unread / new-activity indication is entirely missing despite server support
findings.gap: `ApiClient.updateSessionFlags` (lib/core/services/connection_manager.dart:665-687) already accepts `unread` and `hidden`, but `Session.fromJson` (lib/core/models/session.dart) never parses `unread`, no widget reads it, and opening a chat never clears it. Carlos cannot tell which conversations have new activity — the single most valuable Discord-replacement signal.
findings.value: Very high — this is the core 'instead of Discord tomorrow' feature; the server contract already exists, so it is UI-only.
files: lib/core/screens/workspace_screen.dart (thread onUpdateFlags.unread:false on open; sum unread into shell Chats badge)
lib/core/widgets/hermes_shell.dart (badge the Chats destination with total unread)
findings.proposedTest: 1) session_model_test: Session.fromJson maps `unread:true`. 2) workspace_sessions_screen_test: an unread session renders a dot and bold title; a read session does not. 3) workspace_screen_test: opening a session fires updateSessionFlags(session.id, unread:false) and the shell Chats badge equals the sum of unread sessions. 4) Empty/unread flag from an older gateway degrades to no indicator (no crash).

findings.title: Messages render no timestamp
findings.gap: `MessageBubble` (lib/core/screens/chat_screen.dart:3360-3453) draws only a role header and the markdown body; the raw message map is passed as `metadata` and only surfaced in verbose mode. Discord's per-message time is absent.
findings.value: High — grounds the transcript and makes 'how long did this take' answerable at a glance.
files: lib/core/screens/chat_screen.dart (render created_at/timestamp from `metadata` in the bubble, reusing formatRelativeAge)
findings.proposedTest: chat_display_items_test / a new widget test: a message with a timestamp field shows a relative-time label; a message without one shows no label; the label updates under an injected clock.
findings.serverDependency: Depends on the gateway including created_at/timestamp in message JSON (verify via getMessages; verbose dump already exposes all fields)

findings.title: Chat app-bar menu offers only Refresh + Export — no rename or delete in-chat
findings.gap: The app-bar `PopupMenuButton` (lib/core/screens/chat_screen.dart:2655-2677) has only refresh/export. Rename and delete exist but are reachable only from the Chats browser long-press. Thread `onRename`/`onDelete` callbacks from WorkspaceScreen (which already implement `_renameSession` and `_deleteSession`) into ChatScreen.
findings.value: High — a chat you're inside is where you want to rename or discard it.
findings.effort: Medium (thread two callbacks; rename is Desktop-Gateway-gated, delete is REST)
findings.proposedTest: chat_screen widget test: app-bar menu shows Rename when a rename callback is provided and Delete always; invoking them calls the injected callbacks; rename hidden when the connection lacks a Desktop Gateway URL.
findings.serverDependency: Rename: Desktop Gateway JSON-RPC (session.title). Delete: REST DELETE /api/sessions/{id} (exists)

findings.title: More pane under-reports two capabilities that are already shipped
findings.gap: `buildMoreSections` (lib/core/widgets/more_pane.dart:172-191) still lists 'Pin, batch and undo' as `unavailable` (`_gatewayOrganizationRequired`) and 'AI-assisted filing' as `unavailable` (`_gatewayAiFilingRequired`). But the Chats browser already implements pin/batch/move/archive with undo (lib/core/screens/workspace_sessions_screen.dart), and Settings already exposes a full AI curator (`SessionOrganizerSettingsCard`, lib/core/screens/settings_screen.dart:352-379). The capability-discovery rule ('never hide a capability') is being violated in reverse — real features look absent.
findings.value: Medium-high — discoverability; contradicts the audit doc's own honesty rule.
files: lib/core/widgets/more_pane.dart (mark pin-batch-undo available and route it to the Pinned filter; repoint ai-filing to the organizer settings or reflect its real enabled/dry-run state)
findings.proposedTest: more_pane_test: pin-batch-undo is selectable and its subtitle no longer claims a missing contract; ai-filing reflects the organizer's real availability instead of a hard unavailable gate.

findings.title: Memory screen is read-only — cannot add/edit/delete an entry
findings.gap: `MemoryScreen` (lib/core/screens/memory_screen.dart) only GETs `/api/memory` then falls back to `/api/config`. The product spec (Pilier 4/12) calls for 'save to memory'; there is no write path in the app.
findings.value: High for capturing facts on the go; blocked by server write support.
findings.effort: Medium (UI simple; needs a write endpoint)
files: lib/core/screens/memory_screen.dart (add entry editor + delete; add DashboardClient write methods)
findings.proposedTest: memory screen widget test with a mock DashboardClient asserting add/edit/delete round-trip and honest error on write failure.
findings.serverDependency: Requires the dashboard to expose a memory write endpoint (verify; GET /api/memory exists, write path uncertain)

findings.title: Files screen previews text only — no image/PDF preview
findings.gap: `FilesScreen._openFile` (lib/core/screens/files_screen.dart:98-119) reads text via `readText`; `_previewBody` renders 'Binary preview is unavailable. Download the file to open it.' for anything non-text. For browsing miniserver folders this forces a download for every image/PDF.
findings.value: High for Carlos's folder-browsing workflow (screenshots, PDFs, APKs).
files: lib/core/screens/files_screen.dart (branch on extension/mime: inline Image.network or a PDF viewer, fall back to Download)
findings.proposedTest: files_screen_test: selecting an image entry renders an inline image; selecting a PDF renders a viewer; a binary/unknown type keeps the download affordance.
findings.serverDependency: Needs authenticated media fetch (RemoteFilesClient.download already returns bytes; may need a URL/token approach for streaming images)

findings.title: No message-content search inside a chat
findings.gap: Search (local/full-text/AI) operates on session titles/previews only (SessionSearchController, workspace search). There is no way to find a phrase inside the open conversation's messages.
findings.value: Medium — Discord parity, but larger than the P0/P1 items.
files: lib/core/screens/chat_screen.dart (client-side filter over already-loaded messages, jump-to-match)
findings.proposedTest: widget test: entering a query filters the loaded message list and tapping a result scrolls to it.

findings.title: Notifications are informational only — no approve/reject/deep-link actions
findings.gap: `TurnNotificationService` notifies on turn completion, but Pilier 2 (typed channels, deep links, safe Approve/Reject/Retry from the notification) is not implemented. Approvals are only reachable by opening the chat or the Inbox.
findings.proposedTest: Integration: a pending approval raises a notification with Approve/Reject actions; tapping opens the exact chat and replays the dialog; actions are idempotent.
findings.serverDependency: Needs typed gateway events / stable ids / idempotent resolve RPCs (not yet exposed)

findings.title: No offline chat transcript cache
findings.gap: Pilier 8 requires offline reading clearly marked; currently a chat with no connectivity shows an error, not the last-known transcript.
findings.proposedTest: widget test: with a cached transcript and no network, the chat renders the cached messages behind an offline banner.

findings.title: No quick connection/gateway switcher in the workspace
findings.gap: The app auto-opens the last connection; switching requires backing out to the connection list (lib/main.dart). The workspace app-bar shows the label but offers no way to change it.
findings.value: Low for Carlos's single-miniserver setup; higher if multiple gateways are used.
findings.proposedTest: widget test: tapping the connection switcher shows the saved connections and selecting one navigates to its workspace.

alreadyWellCovered: Projects CRUD (create/rename/archive/restore/delete) with consistent overflow menus and destructive confirmations
Chats browser pin/batch-move/archive/undo, Unassigned/Archived/Pinned/Recent filters, global search (on-device/full-text/AI)
Chat markdown (code blocks with copy/wrap), model/effort selectors, attachments (gallery/camera/server files), STT/TTS, stop response, edit-and-resend, regenerate, export/share
Cron CRUD (add/edit/delete/trigger/pause) with failing-first ranking and attention banner
Inbox with cron-failure/due/approvals banners, biometric lock, encrypted backup/restore, session-source filter
Honest capability gates (Assets tab, AI-filing, Pin/batch in More) — though two of these gates are stale per finding 'more-pane-stale-gates'
